sessions.title: Prophecy Category Board 01
sessions.theme: Sorting prophecy references by major theme

rounds.title: Prophecy Category Board 01

cards.summary: A child called Immanuel is given as a sign.
cards.textShort: Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son.
cards.teachingNote: Matthew explicitly quotes Isaiah 7:14 in the infancy narrative.

cards.summary: A ruler for Israel comes from Bethlehem.
cards.textShort: Out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel.
cards.teachingNote: Matthew directly links Messiah's birthplace with Micah 5:2.

cards.summary: God calls His son out of Egypt.
cards.textShort: Out of Egypt have I called my son.
cards.teachingNote: Matthew reads Israel's story typologically in relation to Jesus.

cards.summary: Garments are parted and lots are cast.
cards.textShort: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.
cards.teachingNote: John explicitly cites the casting of lots as fulfillment of scripture.

cards.summary: The righteous sufferer's bones are preserved.
cards.textShort: He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.
cards.teachingNote: John cites this detail while describing Jesus' death.

cards.summary: The suffering figure receives gall and vinegar.
cards.textShort: In my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
cards.teachingNote: The Gospels connect this detail with Jesus' crucifixion.

cards.summary: The Lord invites David's Lord to sit at His right hand.
cards.textShort: Sit thou at my right hand.
cards.teachingNote: Psalm 110 is one of the New Testament's most frequent messianic texts.

cards.summary: A child is born whose government and peace increase.
cards.textShort: Unto us a child is born... and the government shall be upon his shoulder.
cards.teachingNote: Luke's announcement uses Davidic kingdom language that Christians connect with Isaiah's promise.

cards.summary: Zion's king comes lowly and riding on an ass.
cards.textShort: Thy King cometh unto thee... riding upon an ass.
cards.teachingNote: Matthew explicitly quotes Zechariah during the triumphal entry.

cards.summary: A voice prepares the way of the Lord in the wilderness.
cards.textShort: Prepare ye the way of the Lord.
cards.teachingNote: The Synoptic Gospels connect Isaiah 40:3 with John the Baptist.

cards.summary: A messenger prepares the way before the Lord.
cards.textShort: I will send my messenger, and he shall prepare the way before me.
cards.teachingNote: Mark uses messenger texts to frame John the Baptist's ministry.

cards.summary: Elijah is promised before the great day of the Lord.
cards.textShort: I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great... day.
cards.teachingNote: Matthew presents John the Baptist as fulfilling the Elijah-type role.

cards.summary: Light comes to Galilee and people in darkness.
cards.textShort: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light.
cards.teachingNote: The Gospel citation ties the prophecy to Jesus' public ministry in Galilee.

cards.summary: The servant is upheld by God and brings judgment to the Gentiles.
cards.textShort: Behold my servant, whom I uphold; mine elect.
cards.teachingNote: Matthew's quotation presents Jesus' ministry through Isaiah's servant language.

cards.summary: All families of the earth would be blessed through Abram.
cards.textShort: In thee shall all families of the earth be blessed.
cards.teachingNote: The New Testament explicitly applies this Abraham promise to the gospel going to the nations.
